data.description:
## Observation
After bug 84c7 removed the four ghost rows, **all 9 remaining `KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS` rows
declare an empty prefix**. `_rebar_env: (0, "REBAR_")` was the only row that ever used the
second tuple element, and its helper was drained out of the tree by the RP-04 cutover
(`d361eb28e4`).

The prefix is still applied at `scripts/gen_env_registry.py` `_scan_call`
(`reads.setdefault(prefix + lit, ...)`) and at `scripts/check_config_ownership.py`
`_helper_access` (`return self._resolved_env(node, prefix + lit)`).

## Why it matters
The feature now has **zero production users and zero live end-to-end coverage**. It was
also mis-covered before: `tests/unit/test_gen_env_registry.py` asserted
`REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE in reads` under the comment "a `_rebar_env(\"SUFFIX\")`
reconciler read resolved with the REBAR_ prefix", but that variable has been captured by a
plain inline `os.environ.get("REBAR_RECONCILER_VERBOSE", "0")` at
`_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py:406` since the shim was drained
— so the assertion passed for a different reason than it claimed. 84c7 corrected that
comment but did not add real prefix coverage.

Note the 84c7 fix did add *some* prefix coverage in the ownership gate's held-out fixture
(`test_known_env_helper_call_resolves_and_fires` now asserts `prefix + "SOME_KNOB"`),
but with every live prefix empty that assertion is currently vacuous.

## Options
- **Add a synthetic-tree test** that registers a prefixed row and asserts both scanners
  apply it. Cheap, keeps the feature honest.
- **Remove the prefix field** if nothing is expected to need it again, simplifying both
  tables to a bare int. This is a behaviour-narrowing change and needs its own review.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Either prefixed resolution has a test that fails when the prefix is dropped, or the
      field is removed from both consumers.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck` and `make test` stay green.
- [ ] `docs/env-vars.md` is unchanged by the work (no live row uses a prefix).

## Provenance
Observed while fixing bug 84c7 (surprised-convincing-gopher); recorded rather than repaired
there, because adding coverage for an unused feature is outside the scope of restoring the
table->tree invariant.
data.title: KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS prefix field has no live user and no live coverage
